feed.title: RealHunt: new homes
feed.subtitle: The newest homes on RealHunt, each checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.
feed.rights: Text and figures: CC BY 4.0, with a link. Photos belong to the original listings.

entry.title: €205,000 · Detached 3-bedroom house with garden and mountain views in Zachloritika, Achaea
entry.summary: Zachloritika, Achaea. 132 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. Built in 2016, this detached house spans three levels with 132 m2 of living space, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. It sits on a plot of about 300 m2 with a garden and a private parking space. Features include a fireplace, air conditioning, solar water heating and electric heating, and the windows look out over the mountains. The beach is 2.5 km away and Patras is 49 km away. Asking €205,000, about €1,553/m².

entry.title: €185,000 · Two-level semi-detached villa with shared pool and mountain views in Asproulianos, Crete
entry.summary: Asproulianos, Crete. 66 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. This two-level semi-detached villa has 66 m2 of living space, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a guest WC. Underfloor heating runs throughout, and the living room has a wood burner. A covered tiled terrace on the upper level overlooks the shared pool and has distant sea views, while the property also has a small garden and private covered parking. Georgioupolis sandy beach is 3 to 5 minutes away, and Chania airport is about 45 minutes' drive. Asking €185,000, about €2,803/m².

entry.title: €199,000 · Furnished 2-bedroom townhouse with garden and pool in Trinità d'Agultu e Vignola, Sardinia
entry.summary: Trinità d'Agultu e Vignola, Sardinia. 85 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. This fully furnished end-terraced house has two bedrooms, one with an en-suite bathroom, and two bathrooms in total. The living room includes a kitchenette and opens onto a veranda overlooking the garden and the granite rocks of Gallura. Both bedrooms have direct access to the backyard courtyard. The property includes a private parking space and use of a communal swimming pool. It is located in Costa Paradiso on the north coast of Gallura. Asking €199,000, about €2,341/m².

entry.title: €150,000 · 2-bedroom house with terrace and views in Sinarades, Corfu
entry.summary: Sinarades, Corfu. 125 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 91. The house has three levels with 125 m2 of living space, two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and one bathroom. Both bedrooms are bright, and one opens onto its own balcony above the entrance terrace. The home keeps its original wooden features and has a ground floor cellar, plus a small yard shared with the neighbouring property. Views reach over village rooftops and greenery, and the beaches of Agios Gordios and Kontogialos are close by, with Corfu Town within easy reach. Asking €150,000, about €1,200/m².

entry.title: €175,000 · Farmhouse with pool, views and fireplace in Huércal-Overa, Almería
entry.summary: Huércal-Overa, Almería. 152 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. This farmhouse has two bedrooms, one bathroom with a shower and 152 m2 of living space. The open-plan kitchen and living room has a fireplace, and a spacious covered terrace lies at the front. A private swimming pool sits beside the house on a completely flat, fenced plot with wide views over the landscape. Huércal-Overa is a 10-minute drive away, and the last 200 meters are on a well-maintained unpaved road. The home is connected to mains water and solar electricity. Asking €175,000, about €1,151/m².

entry.title: €174,995 · House with annexe and pool on walled plot in Albox, Almería
entry.summary: Albox, Almería. 189 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. The annexe has three bedrooms, a family bathroom and an open plan lounge and kitchen with a log burner and air conditioning. The main house has one bedroom with an ensuite, a fully fitted kitchen and a lounge with a log burner and air conditioning. The walled plot has a 5x3m pool with a terrace, fruit trees, a pump house and a storage shed. Views over the garden and pool, with Albox 10 minutes away, Taberno 5 minutes and Huércal-Overa 20 minutes. Asking €174,995, about €926/m².

entry.title: €129,600 · 2-bedroom stone farmhouse with barn and open views in Courbiac, Lot-et-Garonne
entry.summary: Courbiac, Lot-et-Garonne. 102 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. This stone farmhouse dates from 1843 and offers 102 m2 of living space across two bedrooms, a kitchen of about 20 sqm with a fireplace. Outside there is an independent guest bedroom of about 16 sqm and a further room of about 11 sqm with toilet and shower room. An open barn of about 75 sqm and a plot of 3,625 sqm complete the property, which has open views and electric heating. It lies about 5 km from Montaigu-de-Quercy and Tournon d'Agenais. Asking €129,600, about €1,271/m².

entry.title: €148,400 · Bright 3-bedroom house with fireplaces and garden in Faye-la-Vineuse, Indre-et-Loire
entry.summary: Faye-la-Vineuse, Indre-et-Loire. 129 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. The house offers approximately 129 m² with three bedrooms, a very bright living and dining room with fireplaces, and a kitchen. It also has a small dining room opening onto a sunny courtyard, a cosy living room, a bathroom, a shower room, two separate WCs and a pantry. Outdoors there is a leafy garden with a small outbuilding. Heating is collective central heating. The house sits in a listed medieval village, 9 minutes from Richelieu. Asking €148,400, about €1,150/m².

entry.title: €165,000 · Character 4-bedroom house with terrace and countryside views in Champallement, Nièvre
entry.summary: Champallement, Nièvre. 204 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. Character house with 204 m2 of living space, 4 bedrooms and 5 rooms, heated by gas-fired central heating. The living room has an open fireplace and ceiling beams, and opens onto a 30 m2 kitchen/dining room overlooking the church. A terrace of about 27 m2 offers panoramic views of the countryside and forest, and the plot includes a garden. It sits beside the church in Champallement, between Corbigny and Brinon-sur-Beuvron, less than 3 hours from Paris. Asking €165,000, about €809/m².

entry.title: €150,000 · 3-bedroom house with fireplace and mountain views in Abanilla, Murcia
entry.summary: Abanilla, Murcia. 116 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. The house is in good structural condition and has 116 m2 of living space, three bedrooms and one bathroom with shower. The living-dining room has air conditioning, a wood-burning fireplace and electric heating, and the kitchen is equipped. Outdoors there is a sunny porch, two private patios, one with a removable pool, a garden and a garage. The property has mountain views and direct access from the house to a hiking trail. The village is a few minutes' walk away. Asking €150,000, about €1,293/m².

entry.title: €179,000 · Townhouse with private garden and communal pool in Sassetta, Tuscany
entry.summary: Sassetta, Tuscany. 60 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 74. End-of-terrace house of 60 m2 with two bedrooms and one bathroom in a secluded residential village. The living area has an open kitchen, and the loft on the upper floor overlooking the living room holds a second bedroom. Each ground floor room opens onto a large private garden. Residents can use a communal pool, and the property includes a private parking space. The Terme di Sassetta are nearby, reached on foot through woods and vineyards. Asking €179,000, about €2,983/m².

entry.title: €99,500 · Cave house with views, large patio and land in Orce, Granada
entry.summary: Orce, Granada. 134 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. This cave house offers 134 m2 across three bedrooms, a living room with dining area, and a typical Spanish kitchen. The generously sized bathroom has a bathtub and shower. A large patio spans the full width of the cave, with views over the surroundings. Behind the property there is firewood storage and a carport, and the cave is connected to water, electricity, and sewage. Orce is a few minutes away, Huéscar about 10 minutes, and Baza about half an hour. Asking €99,500, about €743/m².

entry.title: €140,000 · Country house with garden, land and vineyard in Canelli, Asti, Piedmont
entry.summary: Canelli, Asti, Piedmont. 83 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 76. This country house has two bright bedrooms and a spacious eat-in kitchen with a traditional putagè. The home has gas-fired central heating. Outside there is a pergola, a veranda with a pizza oven, and a storage room beside it. The grounds include approximately 7,000 sqm of adjacent land, of which 5,000 sqm are Moscato vineyards and the rest is garden and fruit orchard. Canelli's centre is only minutes away. Asking €140,000, about €1,687/m².

entry.title: €179,990 · Spacious 4-bedroom stone house with barn and garden in Villemain, Deux-Sèvres
entry.summary: Villemain, Deux-Sèvres. 198 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. The house has 198 m2 of living space, four bedrooms and two large reception rooms, with a fitted kitchen and a laundry room. It is double glazed and heated by oil-fired central heating, and the structure and exterior are in good condition. Outside there is an enclosed garden, an enclosed courtyard for parking and a 40 m2 barn with concrete floor. The market town of Chef Boutonne is a 10 minute drive away, and Niort, Poitiers and Angoulême are 45 minutes away. Asking €179,990, about €909/m².

entry.title: €178,000 · End-of-terrace villa with garden and double garage in Montefollonico, Tuscany
entry.summary: Montefollonico, Tuscany. 110 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. Built in 2000 and in good condition, this end-of-terrace villa offers about 154 square metres over several levels. It has seven rooms, two bedrooms, a study that can serve as a third bedroom, and two bathrooms. The living room has a fireplace and opens onto a private garden of about 44 square metres on two levels, with panoramic views. A double garage and a laundry room are in the basement. Asking €178,000, about €1,618/m².

entry.title: €155,000 · Country house with olive trees and mountain views in Sorbas, Almería
entry.summary: Sorbas, Almería. 135 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. Built in 2005, this country house offers 134 m² of living space. It has three bright bedrooms, two independent living rooms, an independent kitchen and a study. A large porch and a flat 1,480 m² plot with olive trees sit outside, with unobstructed mountain views. Sorbas is 15 minutes away, Campohermoso 10 minutes, and the Cabo de Gata beaches a short distance. Asking €155,000, about €1,148/m².

entry.title: €168,800 · Stone house with 4 bedrooms, enclosed garden and terrace in Chizé, Deux-Sèvres
entry.summary: Chizé, Deux-Sèvres. 172 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. Stone house of 172 m² with 4 bedrooms over two floors, a bathroom and a water room. The ground floor has a 42 m² living-dining room with a wood stove and an 18 m² fitted kitchen. The fully enclosed west-facing garden has 3 levels, and an east-facing courtyard has a terrace. Wood heating can be easily extended with a heat pump, and the house is connected to mains sewer. Asking €168,800, about €981/m².

entry.title: €175,000 · Double-home chalet with sea views and pool in Alcossebre, Costa del Azahar, Castellón
entry.summary: Alcossebre, Costa del Azahar, Castellón. 142 m². 5 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. The chalet spreads over three floors with two independent homes, five bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The living-dining room opens onto a terrace with sea views, and there is a solarium on the upper floor. Panoramic views cover the Mediterranean and the Sierra de Irta Natural Park. It sits in a private urbanization with a communal pool and 24-hour security. The beaches and marina at Las Fuentes are a few minutes' drive away. Asking €175,000, about €1,232/m².

entry.title: €110,000 · House with courtyard terrace, pool and open fireplace in Aigre, Charente
entry.summary: Aigre, Charente. 104 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. This 104 m2 house has three bedrooms and a bathroom on the first floor. The spacious living room is filled with natural light and has an open fireplace, with central oil-fired heating. The house has a private courtyard with a terrace and a small garden, and there is a private parking space. It is part of a small co-ownership of five houses that shares a secure in-ground swimming pool, a garden and a converted barn with a games room. Asking €110,000, about €1,058/m².

entry.title: €165,000 · Townhouse with courtyard, garage and private gardens in Cañada de la Leña, Murcia
entry.summary: Cañada de la Leña, Murcia. 163 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. The property has three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 163 m2 of living area. The living room has a log-burning stove and air conditioning, and the master bedroom is air-conditioned too. Outdoor space includes a private internal courtyard, front and side gardens, and room to install a small plunge pool. A garage with internal access is included. A traditional bar and restaurant is a one-minute walk away, and Alicante Airport is about 45 minutes away. Asking €165,000, about €1,012/m².

entry.title: €215,000 · Move-in-ready 4-bedroom townhouse with pool and garage in Bigastro, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Bigastro, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 224 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. Arranged over several floors, this 224 m² townhouse has four bedrooms and three bathrooms. The bright living room has large windows and air conditioning, and the separate kitchen includes a utility area. Outside there is a front porch, a solarium and a private garage, plus a communal pool and green areas. The finishes are well maintained and the home is shown furnished and ready to move into. Asking €215,000, about €960/m².

entry.title: €210,000 · Single-storey 5-bedroom country house with pool and garage in Hondón de los Frailes, Alicante
entry.summary: Hondón de los Frailes, Alicante. 270 m². 5 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. Single-storey house in excellent condition, offering 267 m² of living area across 8 rooms, including 5 bedrooms and one bathroom. The property is oriented south and east, so rooms receive natural light, and it has a fireplace and a reinforced door with alarm and video surveillance. The 933 m² plot includes a garden, a private swimming pool, a garage and a storage room. It is 1 km from the town centre of Hondón de los Frailes, with fibre optic, cable television and sewage connection. Asking €210,000, about €778/m².

entry.title: €187,700 · Townhouse with heated pool and stairlift in Playa Flamenca, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Playa Flamenca, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 85 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. Ready to move into, this townhouse offers 85 m2 of built area across three double bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a guest toilet. A stairlift serves the upper floor, and there is a separate outdoor laundry area. The private, gated complex has a communal heated pool and recreational areas for use throughout the year. The home is in Playa Flamenca, about 1,600 metres from the Mediterranean beaches and a few minutes from Zenia Boulevard shopping centre. Asking €187,700, about €2,208/m².

entry.title: €215,000 · Move-in-ready 3-bedroom townhouse with garage and pool in Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 80 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. The townhouse is in very good condition and ready to move into without renovation, having been carefully maintained by its owners. It spreads over three floors, with a living-dining room, open-plan kitchen and guest toilet on the ground floor. Two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and their own balconies sit on the first floor, while the third bedroom with en-suite bathroom opens onto a private terrace upstairs. A private garage connects directly to the house, and the portal lists a swimming pool and garden. Asking €215,000, about €2,688/m².

entry.title: €189,000 · Renovated townhouse with roof solarium and sea views in Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 120 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. Fully renovated south-facing townhouse with 120 m2 of living space over two floors and a rooftop. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a front terrace, a second-floor terrace off the master bedroom and a private roof solarium. It is sold fully furnished and equipped, with views of La Mata salt lake, the natural park and the Mediterranean Sea. Urban bus stops, shops and restaurants are just moments away. Asking €189,000, about €1,575/m².

entry.title: €129,950 · Renovated house with beams and terrace in Hondón de los Frailes, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Hondón de los Frailes, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 100 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. Carefully renovated village house with high ceilings and wooden beams kept throughout. The ground floor has a bright living room, an equipped kitchen, a dining room with a fireplace, a bedroom, a bathroom and a private patio. Upstairs, a hallway with wooden beams leads to two more bedrooms and a bathroom. The structure and exterior are in good condition, and bars, restaurants, supermarkets, a pharmacy and a medical centre are a short walk away. Asking €129,950, about €1,300/m².

entry.title: €209,995 · Townhouse with communal pools and private terrace in Cabo Roig, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Cabo Roig, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 75 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 76. This west-facing townhouse has two double bedrooms, a family bathroom with underfloor heating and a ground-floor guest toilet. The living room has a separate dining area, and the spacious kitchen includes a utility area. A glazed front terrace and a private outdoor terrace provide space for dining or relaxing. Residents have access to four communal swimming pools and well-maintained gardens within a private development on the outskirts of Cabo Roig. The living area is 75 m2 on a plot of 1,076 sq ft. Asking €209,995, about €2,800/m².

entry.title: €164,995 · Village house with private pool and covered terrace in Monòver, Alicante
entry.summary: Monòver, Alicante. 176 m². 6 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. Spacious village house with six bedrooms and three bathrooms, with a lounge-dining area, separate dining room and fully equipped kitchen. A covered terrace opens onto the large patio with a private swimming pool and several seating areas. The home has oil-fired central heating, mains water and electricity, plus a garage, utility room and boiler/storage room. It is a 1-minute walk from a restaurant, bodega and car repair garage, and Monòver and Pinoso are both under a 10-minute drive away. Asking €164,995, about €937/m².

entry.title: €205,000 · 3-bedroom house with underbuild and solar panels in Benejúzar, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Benejúzar, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 88 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. The house has three bedrooms, a renovated bathroom and an open-plan living area with a wood-burning stove. A spacious underbuild adds extra rooms, a home office, storage and an additional toilet. Six solar panels with battery storage, double-glazed windows, private parking and a garden shed are included, with access to a nearby communal swimming pool. The property is within walking distance of Vistabella Golf and about 20 minutes' drive from the Costa Blanca beaches. Asking €205,000, about €2,330/m².

entry.title: €194,950 · Renovated 3-bedroom townhouse with garden and storeroom in Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 91 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse in Los Balcones, Torrevieja, offers 91 m2 of living space. All three bedrooms and the family bathroom have been fully renovated. It has a front garden and a sunny rear garden for outdoor dining. A large storeroom provides space for bicycles, suitcases and outdoor furniture. The plot measures 1,432 sq ft of land. Asking €194,950, about €2,142/m².

entry.title: €149,000 · Modern 3-bedroom townhouse with terrace and pellet heating in Casas del Señor, Alicante
entry.summary: Casas del Señor, Alicante. 100 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. The townhouse has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 100 m2 of living area, with double-glazed windows in the living room. Each room has air conditioning, and a pellet cooker provides heating in the colder months. The terrace has a mini bar, and the property includes 807 sq ft of land. The best restaurants in the area are a 5 minute walk away. Monóvar and Pinoso, with all amenities, are about 7 minutes away, and Alicante airport and beaches are around 40 minutes. Asking €149,000, about €1,490/m².

entry.title: €165,000 · Renovated 2-bedroom rural house with fireplace, garden and land in Prado Negro, Granada
entry.summary: Prado Negro, Granada. 60 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. The renovated rural house keeps its rustic character and has two bedrooms, one bathroom, a living room with a fireplace, a dining room and a kitchen across 60 m². It faces south, so it gets plenty of natural light, and has a private garden and sits on more than 13,000 m² of private land. A photovoltaic installation, alarms, video surveillance and a reinforced door are included. The village is about 30 minutes from Granada, and the house is sold with furniture. Asking €165,000, about €2,750/m².

entry.title: €99,000 · Single-storey 3-bedroom detached house with garden and garage in Matanza, León
entry.summary: Matanza, León, Castile and León. 103 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. Built in 1972, this single-storey detached house is in good overall condition. It has 83 m² of built area, 3 bedrooms, a separate fully equipped kitchen with a pantry, and one full bathroom. The private garden includes a small outbuilding and a working well, and the garage has a bar counter and barbecue. The house has individual radiator heating with a fuel-based energy supply, plus fibre-optic internet. The village has a bar, shop, pharmacy and swimming pools. Asking €99,000, about €961/m².

entry.title: €194,900 · Move-in-ready 3-bedroom townhouse with terrace in Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 103 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 79. This ready-to-move-in townhouse offers 103 m2 of living space across three bedrooms and two full bathrooms. A spacious terrace provides outdoor space for enjoying the Mediterranean climate. It sits in the quiet Los Balcones area of Torrevieja, with bus stops nearby. Mercadona supermarket and Torrevieja Hospital are close by, and the nearby tennis club offers a swimming pool, gym and hard tracks for a monthly membership of 60 euros. Asking €194,900, about €1,892/m².

entry.title: €179,000 · Townhouse with terraces and garden in Elche, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Elche, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 62 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. This townhouse is in very good condition and has no overlooking neighbours. It offers a large living room, an open-plan kitchen, two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and one bathroom. Air conditioning is fitted in the living room and the master bedroom. Several terraces catch sun or shade at different times of day, and well-maintained trees surround the house, including palms and olive trees. It sits in a residential area 3 km from La Marina beaches and has a carport for one vehicle. Asking €179,000, about €2,887/m².

entry.title: €149,000 · Townhouse with rooftop solarium, jacuzzi and courtyard in Tolox, Málaga
entry.summary: Tolox, Málaga. 60 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 76. The townhouse has 60 m2 of living space with two double bedrooms and one family bathroom, all finished to a high standard. The bright living area has an open-plan kitchen with direct access to a 40 m2 private courtyard, shaded by a mature grapevine and with a BBQ area. A staircase leads from the courtyard to a 60 m2 roof solarium with a Jacuzzi included and mountain views to the front and back. The property is listed unfurnished. Asking €149,000, about €2,483/m².

entry.title: €95,000 · Renovated 2-bedroom house with rooftop terrace and views in Galera, Granada
entry.summary: Galera, Granada. 82 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. The house has been fully renovated and modernized, with a new kitchen and two bathrooms across two floors. It offers 82 m2 of living space with 2 bedrooms and a self-contained ground-floor studio with its own kitchen and bathroom. Outdoor space includes a fenced terrace and a rooftop terrace of about 6 x 6 meters with views over the village and surrounding mountains. A storage room/garage for one car sits next to the house. Huéscar is 15 minutes away and Baza about 30 minutes. Asking €95,000, about €1,159/m².

entry.title: €198,000 · 2-bedroom bungalow with private garden and terrace in Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 90 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. Ground-floor bungalow built in 2008, in good condition. It offers 90 m² of built area, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and an open-plan living room with kitchen. Private garden of about 100 m², 10 m² covered terrace and 190 m² plot, with hot and cold air conditioning. Sold furnished with an equipped kitchen, plus a storage room and a garage space. Communal pool, green areas and children's play area in the residential complex. Asking €198,000, about €2,200/m².

entry.title: €199,000 · Renovated furnished 2-bedroom bungalow with terrace in Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
entry.summary: Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante. 85 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. Fully renovated and furnished ground-floor bungalow, ready to move into. It has 2 bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, a modern bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a fully fitted kitchen with a washing machine and dishwasher. Outside there is a front porch with awnings, a spacious terrace overlooking a communal garden, and an external storage room. Shopping centres, supermarkets, golf courses and La Zenia Boulevard are within walking distance, and the beaches of Orihuela Costa are a short distance away. Asking €199,000, about €2,341/m².

entry.title: €129,950 · Renovated 3-bedroom cave house with courtyard and terrace in Castilléjar, Granada
entry.summary: Castilléjar, Granada. 140 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. The cave house has been renovated while keeping its natural cave walls, vaulted ceilings and wooden beams. Inside are a living room with an adjoining room, a kitchen with storage room and two modern bathrooms with walk-in showers. A large enclosed courtyard offers ample parking and room for a terrace or garden, plus an 18-metre cave tunnel for a workshop or studio. Castilléjar is 5 to 10 minutes away by car, and Granada is about 1 hour and 40 minutes away. Asking €129,950, about €928/m².

entry.title: €185,000 · Turnkey 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Albi, Tarn
entry.summary: Albi, Tarn. 96 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 79. This turnkey home offers 96 m2 of living space, with 3 bedrooms and air conditioning in the 2 attic bedrooms. The kitchen opens onto a private terrace and a small garden, and the house has a fireplace, electric heating and a garage. The roof was redone in 2024 and the electrical installation is compliant. Shops, bus stops, schools and the university are within walking distance in west Albi. Asking €185,000, about €1,927/m².

entry.title: €109,900 · Move-in-ready 2-bedroom country house with garden and outbuilding in Nouzerines, Creuse
entry.summary: Nouzerines, Creuse. 80 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. The house is ready to move into and needs no special work. It offers 80 m² with a 20 m² living room and wood-burning stove, a 20 m² fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom with shower and toilet, and two bedrooms upstairs. Outside there is a plot of land, an easy-to-maintain garden, an outbuilding and a cellar. The house sits in a small, peaceful hamlet near Nouzerines, Boussac and La Châtre. It suits a second home or weekends away. Asking €109,900, about €1,374/m².

entry.title: €171,000 · Renovated 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Montluçon, Allier
entry.summary: Montluçon, Allier. 130 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. Fully renovated in 2023, this house offers 130 m2 of living space and a fitted, equipped kitchen opening onto a living room. It has 3 bedrooms, a mezzanine, 2 bathrooms and a toilet. The full basement includes a garage, workshop, cellar, laundry room and one additional bedroom. The enclosed plot has a garden and 3,229 sq ft of land, and the house is heated by gas-fired central heating. It is close to all amenities in Montluçon. Asking €171,000, about €1,315/m².

entry.title: €140,000 · Move-in ready furnished cave house with mountain views in Freila, Granada
entry.summary: Freila, Granada. 135 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. Fully furnished cave house with 135 m2 of living space, four bedrooms and one bathroom, ready for immediate occupancy. The kitchen is fully equipped and includes a characterful fireplace, traditional tilework and wooden shutters. A spacious patio with a BBQ area and parking overlooks the mountains and Andalusian countryside. The house sits on a quiet street on the edge of Freila, with Baza about 15 minutes away and Granada around 1.5 hours by car. The natural insulation keeps temperatures pleasant year-round. Asking €140,000, about €1,037/m².

entry.title: €199,000 · House with renovated bathrooms and troglodyte cellar in Montoire-sur-le-Loir, Loir-et-Cher
entry.summary: Montoire-sur-le-Loir, Loir-et-Cher. 142 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. This 142 m2 house has renovated bathrooms, aluminum joinery and mains drainage, with electric heating and a recent wood stove in the living room. The ground floor has a large dining kitchen opening onto the terrace, a bedroom with a shower room and toilet, and a laundry room. Upstairs, two bedrooms include a 32 m2 suite. The 1,125 m2 plot includes a large troglodyte cellar, and the house sits in a very quiet setting 10 minutes from Montoire-sur-le-Loir. Asking €199,000, about €1,401/m².

entry.title: €98,975 · Detached 2-bedroom house with garden and large barns in Les Grands-Chézeaux, Haute-Vienne
entry.summary: Les Grands-Chézeaux, Haute-Vienne. 132 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 89. Detached house with 132 m2 of living space, 2 bedrooms and a roof in good condition. The ground floor has a living room, kitchen with dining area, bedroom, bathroom and separate toilet, and the first floor has a mezzanine bedroom. Outside, a 1930 m2 garden sits behind the house with a laid terrace and two barns of about 80 m2 each plus two smaller barns. Wood heating and a fireplace are listed, and St Sulpice-Les-Feuilles is a 5-minute drive away. Asking €98,975, about €750/m².

entry.title: €125,000 · Turnkey furnished 1-bedroom house with garden and pool in El Ronquillo, Seville
entry.summary: El Ronquillo, Seville. 66 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. Built in 2010, the 66 m² house spans two floors and is in excellent condition, ready to move into or to adapt. entry.title: €168,000 · Furnished 3-level village house with pellet stove in Sillans-la-Cascade, Var, Provence
entry.summary: Sillans-la-Cascade, Var, Provence. 82 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 74. Village house of 82 m² over three levels, sold furnished. entry.title: €192,000 · Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Lavault-Sainte-Anne, Allier
entry.summary: Lavault-Sainte-Anne, Allier, Auvergne. 135 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. Fully renovated five-room house with 135 m2 of living space over two floors. The ground floor has a large entrance hall, a fitted kitchen, a living room and a toilet, while the upper floor offers a second fitted kitchen, a large living room, three bedrooms, a shower room and a toilet. entry.title: €179,983 · 3-bedroom village house with fireplace and large garden in Les Forges, Deux-Sèvres
entry.summary: Les Forges, Deux-Sèvres. 115 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. Immaculate 3-bedroom village house with 115 m2 of living space, 2 bathrooms, and a structure and exterior in good condition. The double aspect lounge has a feature fireplace, and the fully fitted kitchen includes an oven, induction hob and dishwasher. Electric heating and a gravelled terrace lead to a large rear garden of around 3,000 m2 that extends into woodland. A bio shop, restaurant and golf course are within walking distance. Poitiers, with an international airport and TGV station, is 30 minutes away. Asking €179,983, about €1,565/m².
